audience: online stores that run a referral program and reward advocates with ReferralCandy

useCases.title: Check active campaigns and their join links
useCases.text: List the campaigns with their state and join URLs. List the static segments that campaigns can target.

useCases.title: Review referred purchases in the review period
useCases.text: List referred purchases in a time window, or only those still in the review period. List the purchases behind a reward to check its basis.

useCases.title: Ship rewards and mark them delivered
useCases.text: List rewards that are pending fulfillment. After you ship a custom reward, set its status to delivered.

useCases.title: Enroll an advocate and send the welcome invite
useCases.text: Add a contact and try to enroll them in every campaign. The reply gives the referral link for each campaign they joined. Send the welcome email to an enrolled contact.

useCases.title: Record an order and check who referred a customer
useCases.text: Look up who referred a customer, then register the completed order so referrals and rewards can be detected.
